specs.name: majorityElement_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    majorityElement xs h_precond ∈ xs

specs.name: majorityElement_count_gt_half
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = xs.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_count_pos
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = 0

specs.name: majorityElement_count_ge_one
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = 1

specs.name: majorityElement_count_majority
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    2 * xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = xs.length

specs.name: majorityElement_count_bound
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = xs.length

specs.name: majorityElement_replicate
specs.stmt:
∀ (n : Nat) (x : Nat) (h1 : n = 0) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond (List.replicate n x)),
    majorityElement (List.replicate n x) h_precond = x

specs.name: majorityElement_count_nonzero
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    ¬(xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = 0)

specs.name: majorityElement_strict_majority
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    xs.length / 2 = xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond)

specs.name: majorityElement_count_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond xs),
    majorityElement xs h_precond ∈ xs ∧
    xs.count (majorityElement xs h_precond) = xs.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : List Nat) (h : majorityElement_precond args),
    majorityElement_postcond args (majorityElement args h) h

specs.name: majorityElement_count
specs.stmt: theorem majorityElement_count (xs : List Nat) (h : majorityElement_precond xs) : (xs.filter (· == majorityElement xs h)).length > xs.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_beats_all
specs.stmt: List Nat) (h : majorityElement_precond nums) (x : Nat) : (nums.filter (· == majorityElement nums h)).length > (nums.filter (· == x)).length
